name: divorce
title: The divorce: data in the response, controls elsewhere
html:
The divorce: data in the response, controls elsewhere

The response

Data only. Status, ids, timestamps. Nothing says what you may do next.

The controls, out of band

  • Docs and SDKs
  • OpenAPI descriptions
  • MCP tool lists

13.5 MB

GitHub’s OpenAPI description, as one file. An agent given it reads every operation, whatever state the pull request is in.

“Failure here implies that out-of-band information is driving interaction instead of hypertext.”

Roy T. Fielding, “REST APIs must be hypertext-driven”, 2008
say: APIs kept the information and moved the controls out of band: docs, SDKs, OpenAPI, and now MCP tool lists. Agents inherit the divorce: every tool and endpoint is loaded into the context window up front, whatever the current state allows.
